scope: Retrospective temporal holdout of the existing evidence-anchored level model; AI and transfers disabled. Not the financial allocation model and not a blind or archived-as-of forecast.

gini.rule: latest observed value within this window; otherwise exclude

background.inactiveFields: Explicit frozen neutral structural assumptions only when shown not to affect evaluated outcomes with AI/transfers off; no future numeric country values

outcomes.wellbeing: WHR Cantril ladder, 0–10; existing pinned 2026-vintage annual panel
outcomes.gdp: World Bank GDP per person, constant-2015 USD; existing pinned 2026-vintage annual panel

fit: Only three existing OLS anchor coefficients: intercept, ln(GDP per person), governance; existing fitter with explicit training years; no test-era outcomes/features
cohort: Existing repository country roster; frozen using valid historical background and both 2018 origin outcomes only, before test outcomes are read. Training rows use only valid background and paired training outcomes; no future-availability condition.
missingness: No invented observations, cross-country imputation or future-to-past filling. Score each outcome independently wherever observed; list every excluded or unscored row with reason. Missing final years never remove earlier scores.
baseline: Persistence of each country’s 2018 outcome, identical scoring masks and horizons
primaryMetric: Wellbeing MAE in ladder points, equally weighted observed country-years, plus model minus persistence MAE
secondaryMetrics: per-year and per-country wellbeing errors with denominators
GDP cumulative growth error in percentage points: MAE, RMSE and bias
emptyOrUndefinedMetrics: null with a reason; never zero success
integrityGates: future outcome perturbations cannot change fit, frozen cohort or predictions
origin/test boundary and all sources/parameters hashed
frozen coefficients supplied every monthly step
default behavior unchanged when override omitted
same score masks for model and persistence
vintageLimit: Historical observation years from data retrieved later are not an archive of information published in 2018; revisions and publication lags remain. Model form and structural assumptions were chosen after evaluation years were known.
prohibited: tune coefficients, split, horizon, exclusions or settings to win this test
alter existing published targets or default fitted coefficients
claim this tests disabled AI, transfer or training effects
borrow old qualification for changed source identity
